The '''architect droid''' was a model of construction [[Droid/Legends|droid]] created during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]] was an architect droid who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as an instructor for [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] construction.
